issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other 64,973 (Combined Utilities Fund column)
issues.issue: The line is assumed to be utility collections. If that assumption holds, the user's category is Utility Charges (rule 2026-10-28), not generic charges for services. The printed label only says 'Other'.
Capital outlay lines should be labelled 'Capital Outlay: Streets' (or the matching function), with the printed text in printed_label.
